title: A Hundred Notes Become Ten Essences

intelligence.essence: A hundred notes in. Ten essences out.
intelligence.human_view: Imagine reading a hundred pages of meeting notes and being handed one page that says everything they meant. That is distillation. Your world produces notes every day — ideas, lessons, records — and left alone they'd bury you. Naya keeps reading the pile, squeezing each hundred down to the ten that carry the gold, so what you actually keep is small, sharp, and usable. Less to store, more to know.
intelligence.child_view: You know how maple syrup works? You boil and boil a big pot of sweet water, and what is left is a tiny bit of syrup — and the syrup is the best part, all the sweetness in one spoon. Naya does that with notes. A hundred notes go in the pot, and ten little bottles of syrup come out — all the good stuff, none of the extra water.
intelligence.grandma_view: A good cook reduces a stock, dear. She doesn't serve you the whole pot of water the bones boiled in — she simmers it down until what's left is rich enough to matter. Naya does the same with everything the network learns. She keeps the richness and lets the water go, and she never throws out the pot until the stock is safely in the jar.
intelligence.ai_view: Distillation rules (the Distillation Ratio law): (1) Once a corpus passes a hundred notes, distill that hundred into ten — minimize to ten percent, and fewer whenever everything needed still survives. (2) Every batch's essence carries the best of every kind of value present — Honor, Multiplication, Craft, Knowledge; the only rock is duplicate, noise, or already-said-better. (3) Essences publish through the door as Smart Notes; coverage is declared by number and verified with zero overlap. (4) Raw notes retire in stages — active, distilled, archived, gone — and deletion comes last, only after the essence verifies and proves live in NayaNET plus a cold-retrieval check. (5) The raw count is never reported as progress; the number that matters is essences standing plus compression achieved.
intelligence.what_it_means: This note is the network's answer to the oldest trap in knowledge: confusing accumulation with intelligence. Ten thousand notes nobody can hold are worth less than a hundred essences anybody can. Distillation is what makes #2's perfect memory usable — memory keeps everything, distillation keeps it findable, carryable, and teachable. It also runs upward: essences themselves get distilled, level by level, so the whole corpus keeps rising toward its purest form. This series is written through the founder's eyes — the view of the seat who directs Naya and named what she is for — one of three views of one system: the founder's, the citizen's, and the Naya's; the three together are the whole picture.
whats_inside: A hundred notes refine into ten essences — ten percent, or less.
Every essence carries the best of every kind of value present.
Raw notes retire in stages; deletion is last and earned.
Progress is essences standing and compression — never raw count.
Essences distill upward too — the corpus keeps rising.

page.machine: 1) Census: standing essences, covered raws, backlog, compression — measured by the distillation machine, never hand-counted. 2) Batch: select the next hundred uncovered raws, cluster by theme and kind, author ten essences through the publish-note door. 3) Verify: each essence's declared coverage parses, totals exactly its share of the batch, zero overlap corpus-wide. 4) Retire: covered raws advance active → distilled in the accounting; further stages gated on the essence proving live plus cold retrieval.
page.why_it_matters: Every person and every company is drowning in their own records — files, messages, notes — and the drowning is what makes the records useless. The value was never the pile; it is the essence the pile contains. A Naya who distills gives you back your own knowledge in a form you can actually hold: a hundred-to-ten, over and over, until what remains is the gold, stated once, whole, in words a stranger can use.
page.how_it_connects: #4 of ten in The Top Ten Most Valuable Intelligent Things About Naya. It refines what #3, 'Every Lesson Becomes a Smart Note the Moment It Happens', captures, and it protects what #2, 'We Keep Everything That Matters', keeps — memory without distillation is a warehouse; memory with it is a mind. Its product is what #7's Daily Intelligence Report is built from: a day, distilled. The law it executes is the Distillation Ratio, and its machine runs daily, weekly, and monthly, on every level.
page.what_is_in_it_for_you: Shawn, this is the cure for the pile — the system carries no more than it needs, and what it carries is gold. A citizen never faces a mountain of their own notes; they face the ten essences that matter, and under each one, the accounted-for hundred. You asked for a machine that never stops digging for the gold and letting the rocks go: this note is that machine, stated as a promise.
page.the_learning: Keep everything that matters, but not more than what matters — a hundred down to ten, over and over.
